reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts for the UI.

duplication.why: No logic is re-written; the new field is one call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity in api-models.ts, where the API schedule shape is defined.

scope.why: One type field, one mapping line, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to how a schedule's amount is planned reaches the API automatically through the shared helper.
